mapper.select: SELECT u.USER_ID AS userId, u.NAME AS name, u.EMAIL AS email, u.STATUS AS status, COALESCE(r.cnt, 0) AS reportCount, u.REG_DT AS regDt FROM TB_LOGIN u LEFT JOIN (SELECT REPORTED_USER_ID AS uid, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM TB_REPORT GROUP BY REPORTED_USER_ID) r ON r.uid = u.USER_ID WHERE COALESCE(r.cnt, 0) >= #{minReports} AND u.ROLE_ID = 3 ORDER BY r.cnt DESC, u.REG_DT DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT u.USER_ID AS userId, u.NAME AS name, u.EMAIL AS email, u.STATUS AS status, COALESCE(r.cnt, 0) AS reportCount, u.REG_DT AS regDt FROM TB_LOGIN u LEFT JOIN (SELECT REPORTED_USER_ID AS uid, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM TB_REPORT GROUP BY REPORTED_USER_ID) r ON r.uid = u.USER_ID WHERE u.REG_DT >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND u.ROLE_ID = 3 ORDER BY u.REG_DT DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_LOGIN SET STATUS = 2 WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND ROLE_ID = 3
UPDATE TB_LOGIN SET STATUS = 1 WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND ROLE_ID = 3
